main_text.l: Zelotypiæ quanta sit pestis in conjugio?
5. Parentibus anima liberi. Hic agitur Deparen-tibus:
De σοφίᾳ[?], natura implantata parentibus, etiam brutis.
Quare matres liberos impensiùs ament, quam patres?
Quare matres sæpiùs, quam patres, suos liberos interficiant?
6. Liberi parentes suos honoranto[?] opere, sermone, & patientiâ. Hic agitur Deliberis:
De virtutibus, in quibus spectetur honor,
8. Heroum filii, noxæ. Hic recensentur causæ,
quare filii à parentum virtute & felicitate

page.notes: The Greek words in the lines "De σοφίᾳ" and "De ἀσοφίᾳ" are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. "honoranto" is marked [?] as well, since the scan may read "honorando". The initial "D" of "DEI" may be a larger letter or a decorative mark, so the reading "DEI" is uncertain. The catchword "Libe-" is at the lower right, below the last line.
